_comment: The Inklands: regions, biomes and provinces (issue #53). Coordinates: pos and label are 0-1 on the world map (x east, y south); the Blank's wall runs down the east edge. regions: open (open at the start), chapter (the story chapter that opens it; locked regions show under fog with their hint), opens_when (optional Story conditions, see Story.meets; story beats can also open one with then: open_region:<id>), pressure (optional extra Fray a day on every open province in the region, listed in its panel), label (where the region name sits). biomes: maps = the mission map pool (maps/<id>.txt, three layouts per biome made by tools/make_biomes.py; each map lists its objective spots in @spot lines and MissionTypes.vary picks among them, issue #113); an empty pool falls back to frayed_meadow and each chapter adds its region's maps. provinces: region, biome, weight > 1 grows a province. owner: you, free, erased or a faction id from data/factions.json. Output is per day. favors: the stat a governor here needs (7+ = good fit, 3 or less = poor fit); favors_why says why. claim: cost to plant your flag on an unclaimed province next to your land (it needs a governor to go with it). landing: true lets you claim it without owning a neighbour, once its region is open: the way into a region whose borders are all faction land (the Vauclair Terraces, which the masquerade gate asks for, issue #138).

regions.name: The Brack Marches
regions.hint: Hollowmark and the land around it. Grass grows in half-sentences.

regions.name: Saint Ledger's Abbey
regions.hint: Bells in the north. Monks copying the Ledger by hand, in blood, and running out of ink.

regions.name: The Velvet Causeway
regions.mood: Decadent bridge-city on a lake of ink
regions.hint: Music across the ink lake. A masquerade that has not stopped since the Blank came.

regions.name: The Unfinished Coast
regions.hint: The sea stops mid-wave. Ships sail into the white and do not come back.

regions.name: The Gilded Spire
regions.hint: The capital, and the Great Ledger itself. The Concord will not open the gates for a nobody.

provinces.name: Hollowmark
provinces.favors_why: A market town runs on talk and favours.
provinces.blurb: A seedy market town nobody legally owns. Now it's yours, which is worse.

provinces.name: Frayed Meadow
provinces.favors_why: Half-eaten land needs someone who will not flinch.
provinces.blurb: Grass grows in half-sentences. You crawled out of the Blank here.

provinces.name: Gutterwoods
provinces.favors_why: The Coven respects people who read the signs.
provinces.blurb: Trees grow from discarded letters. The Coven decides who leaves.

provinces.name: Old Mill Crossing
provinces.favors_why: Somebody has to fix the millrace.
provinces.blurb: The mill still turns. Nobody has seen the miller since the Blank came.

provinces.name: Wickham Hills
provinces.favors_why: Only a scholar can coax the ink spring.
provinces.blurb: The only place for miles where ink still wells up from the ground.

provinces.name: Saltreed Marsh
provinces.favors_why: Something in the reeds knows your name. Steady nerves only.
provinces.blurb: Half the reeds have gone white. The other half are whispering about it.

provinces.name: Gallows Ferry
provinces.favors_why: The Guild only listens to a bigger blade.
provinces.blurb: Guild mercenaries run the river crossing and charge both ways.

provinces.name: Tithe Road
provinces.favors_why: The clerks can be talked round. Slowly.
provinces.blurb: The road to the capital. Concord clerks audit everyone who walks it.

provinces.name: Whitewater
provinces.favors_why: Rewriting erased land is scholar's work.
provinces.blurb: There was a village here. The Blank kept the outline and ate the rest.

provinces.name: Candleford
provinces.favors_why: The chandlers keep a hundred wicks burning. Someone has to keep the wax coming.
provinces.blurb: A lake town that makes the Abbey's candles. Every window burns all night, just in case.

provinces.name: Saint Ledger's Abbey
provinces.favors_why: The monks only answer someone who can quote the Ledger back at them.
provinces.blurb: Monks copy the Ledger by hand, forever, in blood. Lately the pages come out blank.

provinces.name: Bonefield Cloister
provinces.favors_why: The ground is soft here, and the monks do not dig. Steady nerves only.
provinces.blurb: An outlying cloister on ground the Ledger says was always empty. The ground disagrees.

provinces.name: Scarth Pass
provinces.favors_why: Bandits, pilgrims and worse use the pass. Someone has to hold it.
provinces.blurb: A mountain pass of pines with feather-shaped needles. The road east ends in white.

provinces.name: Tollmarch
provinces.favors_why: The march answers to whoever holds the wall.
provinces.blurb: The walled march at the end of the Tithe Road. Everyone pays to pass, including the wind.

provinces.name: Ledsham
provinces.favors_why: Clerks respect whoever spots the error first.
provinces.blurb: The clerks' quarter, where history is edited weekly, by committee, with biscuits.

provinces.name: The Gilded Spire
provinces.favors_why: The capital runs on flattery, bribes and very good stationery.
provinces.blurb: The capital. Gold on the outside, rot on the inside, the Great Ledger in the middle.

provinces.name: Goldwash Fields
provinces.favors_why: The farmers trust someone who will stand in the field with them.
provinces.blurb: The farms that feed the capital. The farmers are taxed on the grain and on the rain.

provinces.name: Lantern Quay
provinces.favors_why: The dockhands follow the biggest blade on the quay.
provinces.blurb: Where the Causeway's barges unload, and where things fall off them.

provinces.name: The Velvet Causeway
provinces.favors_why: Nobody on the Causeway listens to anyone who can't dance.
provinces.blurb: A bridge-city on a lake of ink. The elite dance at the masquerade while the water rises.

provinces.name: Pendower Shallows
provinces.favors_why: Only a scholar can tell a good catch of words from a cursed one.
provinces.blurb: The ink lake runs shallow here. Fishermen net words out of it and sell them by the pound.

provinces.name: Vauclair Terraces
provinces.favors_why: The presses are old and the vines are fussy. Someone has to mend both.
provinces.blurb: Terraced vineyards that supply the masquerades. The grapes have started to taste of paper.

provinces.name: Trevail Harbour
provinces.favors_why: Half the fleet needs patching before it can sail anywhere.
provinces.blurb: Ships still leave Trevail. They sail east into the white, and nobody writes back.

provinces.name: Halfwave Bay
provinces.favors_why: Living next to a sea that stopped takes a strong stomach.
provinces.blurb: The sea stops mid-wave here. Children dare each other to touch the edge.

provinces.name: Polgarrow Light
provinces.favors_why: The keeper speaks in riddles. Only a scholar keeps up.
provinces.blurb: A keeper still tends a light that shines out over nothing. Sometimes the nothing answers.
